screens.description: Background activity across the system — running tasks and recent events.
screens.label: Activity

screens.description: Enter and live-test the API keys and cloud/graph credentials the system needs.
screens.label: API Keys

screens.description: The wizard that launches a gated engagement against a URL, API, codebase, or infra target.
screens.label: New Assessment

screens.description: Continuous proof / drift — diff the oracle-confirmed fact set between two runs (regressions vs fixes).
screens.label: Assurance

screens.description: The reasoning brain — the propose-only decision engine (an ordered attack chain of gated LEADs), intelligence, memory, priors, and the capability catalog.
screens.label: Brain

screens.description: Authorization + the who/when/what usage-attestation ledger; provision a loopback authority (a remote charter needs an out-of-band ceremony).
screens.label: Charter & Attestation

screens.description: Tell the agent in natural language what to test; it launches the same gated run and streams it here.
screens.label: Chat

screens.description: Map oracle-proven findings to OWASP / CWE / PCI-DSS / SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls + MITRE ATT&CK.
screens.label: Compliance

screens.description: The defensive AEGIS side — detections, posture, and the managed gateway.
screens.label: Defense (AEGIS)

screens.description: The confirmed findings and attack paths from your runs, oracle-graded.
screens.label: Findings

screens.description: Proposed fixes and patches for confirmed findings; each queues for your approval.
screens.label: Fixes

screens.description: Read-only governance & gate audit — GOVERNED vs UNGOVERNED entitlement, the sovereignty tier, the conjunctive safety-gate, and the m-of-n destruction quorum read from disk. The UI cannot provision, authorize, or fire a governed action.
screens.label: Governance

screens.description: The command dashboard — system status, quick actions, and where to go next.
screens.label: Home

screens.description: The knowledge engine — an auto-updating vulnerability-intelligence feed (leads, never facts) and the defensive knowledge catalog.
screens.label: Knowledge Engine

screens.description: Watch an active or recent run stream live — its findings, tools, and events as they happen.
screens.label: Live

screens.description: The in-app manual — how the system works and how to use each feature.
screens.label: Manual

screens.description: The Certificate of Non-Exploitability — a signed, coverage-bounded, offline-verifiable proof that, over the surface the scanner reached, an applicable oracle had a live channel and did not fire; shows CLOSED/OPEN/UNPROVEN claims per surface, the coverage denominator, the honest residual, the out-of-band fingerprint pin, and the exact offline-verify command.
screens.label: Proof of Posture

screens.description: Oracle-confirmed, signed, replayable exploit proofs — a FACT means an oracle re-fired over captured raw bytes.
screens.label: Proof Studio

screens.description: Import an external VIGIL report/finding JSON and re-fire its retained oracle proofs OFFLINE — pure re-computation, no target, no traffic; a tampered proof renders CONTRADICTED, never a green reproduction.
screens.label: Replay Proof

screens.description: A live, re-verified, proof-carrying client report — every finding re-checks its certificate offline.
screens.label: Report

screens.description: The owner approval queue and safety controls — approve a queued action or trip the kill-switch.
screens.label: Approvals & Safety

screens.description: Your permanent engagement sessions — open, rename, connect, and remove them; each has its own knowledge graph.
screens.label: Sessions

screens.description: System settings — the AI model, effort, providers, and other configuration.
screens.label: Settings

screens.description: A governed local terminal — ask in English or type a command; the AI proposes, the allowlist and gate decide, you approve, and only local read-only commands run (every run signed).
screens.label: Terminal

screens.description: The tool arsenal — what is installed, what each does, and on-demand provisioning.
screens.label: Tools

screens.description: VIGIL's signed, offline-verifiable certificates rendered as certificates — trust root, out-of-band fingerprint pin, and a live offline PASS/FAIL verification.
screens.label: Trust Center
